misconceptions.claim: You must wait 3 months between uses
misconceptions.correction: An uncited community rule of thumb — no reliable data supports a fixed recovery clock. What **is** measured is same-session tolerance: a second dose the same night gives diminished returns and a worse comedown, not a better peak.

citations.note: Peiró 2013 · single vs. repeated dose PK/PD

misconceptions.claim: MDMA plus an SSRI is dangerous
misconceptions.correction: Mostly a myth. Serotonin reuptake inhibitors occupy SERT and **blunt** MDMA's effects — you feel *less*, not more. Serotonin syndrome from MDMA is real, but it overwhelmingly involves **MAOIs** or several serotonergic drugs together, not an SSRI on its own.

misconceptions.claim: It burns holes in your brain
misconceptions.correction: No. Human imaging shows a reduced serotonin-transporter (SERT) binding **association** — a surrogate marker, not holes or lesions, and probably a reversible downregulation; long-abstinent users show no lasting deficit. The frightening picture came from primate studies dosing far higher and more often than people ever do — and the notorious 2002 paper claiming dopamine-neuron death was **retracted** after the animals turned out to have been given **methamphetamine, not MDMA**.

citations.note: Selvaraj 2009 · no deficit in former users

pullQuote.attribution: Leslie Iversen, pharmacologist — to The Scientist, on the retraction

combinations.name: MAOIs
combinations.description: Life-threatening serotonin toxicity. The MAOI blocks serotonin breakdown while MDMA floods it into the synapse. Do not combine.

combinations.name: Alcohol
combinations.description: Adds dehydration and a rougher comedown. It doesn't make MDMA run hotter, but it strains temperature control and hides how dehydrated you are.

combinations.name: SSRIs / SNRIs
combinations.description: Usually just weakens MDMA — the SSRI blocks the serotonin transporter, so less is released. You feel less, not more. Not the danger it's rumored to be.

waterHeat.headline: ≈ 1 glass / hour
waterHeat.body: MDMA heats you up on its own, so sip water while active — about a glass (250 mL) an hour, less at rest. **More is not safer:** too much plain water drops your sodium dangerously low. Favor electrolytes over gulping water.
